asr.full_text: How to apply a smart contract to the contract on the 4CM? Let me introduce to your attention first ever absolutely fully decentralized metrics project Forsage. Forage means fast and furious. What does decentralized mean? What are the benefits for you for such marketing created with a smart contract? A smart contract provides you with maximum security and stability. Smart contract is an algoritm within the blockchain of one of the cryptocurrencies, among which Ethereum is the undisputed leader. And it was on the Ethereum platform that FORSACHE was created. Smart contracts, like cryptocurrencies, are decentralized. All agreement and terms of the smart contract are laid down in the program, and they become unshakable. The code containing all the logic of the contract is placed on the blockchain network. All further calculations are provided by millions of computers around the World. Hence there is no center can be hacked. So even the creators can not cancel or change conditions No one can take your money or limit your income Thanks to this, the participants are more confident in developing their business So here your growth is not limited by the risks of a regular projects How does Forsage marketing work? Forsage marketing is a classic matrix that is the most effective system in terms of money. The matrix consists of small slots for which there are no validity periods. Cycles are repeated by filling places and rain vests. The reinforcement logic for the rain vests is simple – it is based on referral linking, the partner you have invited always follows you in each of the slots. In the X3 program below you is one line in three places. In the X4 program below you are two lines – 2 places in the first line and four places in the second. When you register in Forsage you open both programs simultaneously. Slots. Each of two programs x3 and x4 has 12 slots, they all are identical and work in the same way. Each subsequent slot is exactly two times more expensive than the previous one. Accordingly, income from them are also twice as high. All active slots move and bring you revenue in parallel. How many slots can be activated immediately? As much as you want, even all 12 at once. They have no expiration date. So you can not be afraid that they will burn. The general recommendation is to start directly to 3 slots, although leaders usually take more from the start. Registration The first slot of each program costs 0.025 ETH, but you can not buy them separately. They are bought together at registration. Accordingly, to register in Forsage you need 0.0025 ETH and you can acquire all other slots separately in order from the smaller to the larger. They will develop in parallel but independently. ForceAge X3 The X3 program is shorter therefore it is filling up faster and active partners have more income here. In most cases your personal referral partners are in your slot. When you invite partners they take places under you. Spillover are also possible in case, where overtaking or other partners occurs. That's why it is advantageous to occupy places in slots as early as possible. The distribution of payment when filling out the matrix automatically occurs as follows. The first partner takes a place below you, a 100% payout instantly credited to your personal wallet. The second takes a second place below you Payment also instantly goes to your wallet. And when the third partner takes third place, you again receive 100% income but in the form of reinvest. Reinvest opens the same slot again. And you continue to receive income from it. When your partner reaches reinvest, they also reopen the slot. And they fill an empty place under you. Accordingly 100 percent from reinvest is transferred immediately to your wallet. There may be situation when your partner is more active than you. For example it takes first place in your slot. The second place under use is still free while the partner has already filled his slot and is goes to reinvest. So he takes your second place. And it is even possible that one active partner creates your movement and income. Forsage X4 In parallel with X3 you have the X4 program running. For some partners, X4 is more attractive due to Spell-lovers. There can be any filling options. Perhaps you invited all of 6. Perhaps not one person individually invited by you. That is completely due to Spell Lovers. Or maybe mix it. Incoming x4 – we get from the second line. Partners, who occupy two places below you in the first line, are two places in the second line in your upline. 100% of your payment goes to the wallet of your higher pattern you also receive income from the second line hundred percent from four partners three payments of 100% are instantly sent to your wallet the last period closes the slot and it reinvests buying used the same slot again your partners also go for reinvestment and hundred percent of the payment for the last place of their slot is transferred to your wallet. Thanks to Reinvest system, once you open a slot you are already moving in it a circle constantly, like your partners and you will always receiving income from it. Reinvest happens automatically. As soon as the last three spaces filled, the current slot closes and goes to the acair. After reinvestment a partner occupies an empty place in an applied slot and opens his own new slot with three spaces and hundred percent of the payments for the reinvest of your partner go to your wallet. Thus through reinvestments from each slot can be unlimited. But we have twelve slots in each programs, and will receive income from all of them. It is for this that there are upgrades. Upgrade is the opening of the next slot of a more expensive level. An upgrade is any first purchase of slots , upgrade is necessary for your partners to move after you, way to grow the structure of the team. How to motivate them? In other matrices a centralized lever is usually used, namely AUTO-UPGRADE. To do this they need to collect at least 2 payments, which means that funds are accumulated in the system. But such accumulation violates the principles and is not consistent with the declared 100% payments to partners network. And in Forsage really all 100% goes to partners. Each payment is always immediately send to wallet of one of the participants. In Forsage the task of upgrading solved differently, there is enough income from each slot both for reinvest and for the purchase of a next level slot. The partners will upgrade themselves and reinvest happens automatically because for it there is no need to accumulate. If the participant does not have the next slot open then from the second round after reinvestment, old payments will be redirected to the upline. To receive payment after reinvest you need to upgrade. However, it makes sense not to even wait for the reinvest, but to upgrade immediately after the first 2 payments in order to be at the slot of the next level before the partners. Transfers, overtake and returns You can overtake your upline partner by acquiring slots to which he has not yet reached. In this case, you get up to his upline, the closest who has such a slot, and the income goes to him. If, however, that one does not have the necessary slot available, then you are already overtaking two appliances on more, until the system find a partner who already has the required slot paid. Referral binding allows you to return everything in place. This means that when your applyn buys the same slot, then the next reinvest you will, again, take a place under him. Thus, retained, personal referral patterns forever. As you can see, almost every step in the matrix gives you immediately tangible results. At the same time, there is a constant inevitable growth. To take advantage of all marketing, is to turn on the forcing of your money machine. To turn on Fast and Furious. Let's calculate how you can have income. For example, in the first week you went through a circle of the first level slot. At X3 your income is 0.007 ETH and at X4 0.10 ETH. In the second week you went through a circle of 2nd slot and in the first slot you went one more circle . And the income is already 0.3 plus 0.4 ETH. If you move this way one slot a week, then in 12 weeks you will go to the 12th slot and your full income will be 0.03X$0.0XPX and 0.04X$0TH with x4 – total 1430 ETH, at the rate of 250 – $350 000. And then you no longer need upgrades – all slots are activated, and endlessly through a circle of reinvest bring your income. Recommended start option. The most balanced option for the majority is to start with 3 slots of both programs at once. The entry amount is 0.35 ETH, which is not too much and not too small. Most know this recommendation and follow it. Recommend that your partners do the same so they do not lose profits. Leaders usually open more slots so that, in case of fast movement in the team and upgrades of downline, they will have places earlier. With this approach, your team has more turnovers. In any case, as you can see everything in marketing is thought out so that there is a dynamic movement at all stages without the delays that are characteristic of other projects. Nothing limits development! Your business is safe safe here so aim for a long-term development in for size so that your money machine will work at fast and furious full power for many years
